key-effect.player: {player} must move the Messenger or replace the 3 {place, select, 1{Castle} other{Village}} cards
buy.you: Buy a card or take a card face-down
buy.player: {player} must buy a card or take a card face-down
move-messenger: The Messenger moves and the locations are completed
discard.you: Discard one of the 3 {place, select, 1{Castle} other{Village}} cards
discard.player: {player} must discard one of the 3 {place, select, 1{Castle} other{Village}} cards
choose-effect.player: {card}: {player} must choose one of the effects
activate-adjacent.you: Choose an adjacent card to activate its ability
activate-adjacent.player: {player} must choose an adjacent card to activate
discard-entire-river.you: Choose a row to discard: <0>Castle</0> or <1>Village</1>
discard-entire-river.player: {player} must choose a row to discard

header.you.immediate.default.effect: Your card effect is being applied
header.you.immediate.put.gold.effect: You place Gold on purse cards
card.deck: There are {number, plural, one{# card} other{# cards}} left in the {place, select, 1{Castle} other{Village}} deck.
card.discard: This card is in the {place, select, 1{Castle} other{Village}} discard pile. <1>If a deck is empty when cards are to be revealed from it, the corresponding discard pile is shuffled to form a new deck.</1>
help.discard.count: There {number, plural, one{is # card} other{are # cards}} in this discard pile.
card.river:
This card is in the river. It can be bought if the Messenger pawn is in this location.
It can also be placed face-down in your tableau, to earn 6 Gold and 2 Keys.
card.river.face-down: You can place this card face-down in your tableau to earn 6 Gold and 2 Keys.
card.tableau.you: This card is in your tableau.
card.tableau.face-down: This card has been added face-down to the tableau. Its owner has gained 6 Gold and 2 Keys by doing so, but it will have no effect when calculating scores.
card.shield.help:
There are 6 types of shields:
Nobility: <0/>, Faith: <1/>, Scholarship: <2/> (mostly found in the Castle)
Military: <3/>, Craftsmanship: <4/>, Peasantry: <5/> (mostly found in the Village)
card.messenger: <0/>: if this card is purchased, the Messenger will go to the {place, select, 1{Castle} other{Village}}
card.effect: {effects, plural, one{Effect} other{Effects}} triggered on purchase:
card.effect.choice: When purchasing, choose one of the following effects:
card.effect.keys: Gain {keys, plural, one{# Key} other{# Keys}} from the reserve.
card.effect.keys.per: Gain {keys, plural, one{# Key} other{# Keys}} from the reserve <condition/>.
card.effect.keys.opponents: Your opponents gain 1 Key from the reserve.
card.effect.keys.all: All players gain 1 Key from the reserve.
card.effect.gold.opponents: Your opponents gain {gold} Gold from the reserve.
card.effect.purse: Place 2 Gold from the reserve on each card in your tableau with a Purse in its Scoring scroll.
card.effect.purse.fill:
Place Gold coins on 2 cards on your board with a Purse in their Scoring scroll until they are filled.
<1>(the game automatically chooses the most favorable option)</1>
card.effect.discard.gold: Discard one of the 3 cards (of your choice) in the {place, select, 1{Castle} other{Village}} row, then gain its cost in Gold.
card.effect.discard.keys: Discard one of the 3 cards (of your choice) in the {place, select, 1{Castle} other{Village}} row, then gain as many Keys as its Gold cost.
card.effect.discard-entire-river: Discard all the cards from one row (Castle or Village), then refill it.
card.effect.activate-adjacent: Activate the effect of one adjacent card (horizontally or vertically) in your tableau.
card.lock: Lock ability (spend the Key on this card to activate):
card.lock.info: This is a <0>lock card</0>. A key is placed on it when purchased. Spend the key to activate the ability below.
card.discount.place: The {place, select, 1{Castle} other{Village}} cards cost 1 less to buy (minimum 0).
card.discount.both: All cards (Castle or Village) cost 1 less to buy (minimum 0).
card.scoring.condition: Worth {score, plural, one{# point} other{# points}} at the end of the game <condition/>.
if.position.line: if it is in the {line, select, 1{first} 2{second} other{third}} row
if.position.column: if it is in the {column, select, 1{first} 2{second} other{third}} column
if.position.corner: if it's in a corner of your tableau
if.position.border: if it is on one of the 4 edges (not a corner) of your tableau
if.shield.missing: if there is no <0/> shield in your tableau
if.shield.row: if there is a <0/> shield in the same row
if.shield.column: if there is a <0/> shield in the same column
if.flipped: if there is a card (Castle or Village) placed face-down in your tableau
if.no-discount: if there is no discount card in your tableau
if.no-purse: if there is no Purse card in your tableau
if.no-face-down: if there is no face-down card in your tableau
per.shield: for each <0/> shield in your tableau
per.shield.line: for each <0/> shield on the 3 cards of this row
per.shield.column: for each <0/> shield on the 3 cards of this column
per.shield.both: for each <0/> shield on the 5 cards of this row AND this column
per.shield.neighbor: for each <0/> shield of one neighbor (the one with the most)
per.shield.set.2: for each set of 1 <0/> shield and 1 <1/> shield, wherever they are in your tableau
per.shield.set.3: for each set of 1 <0/> shield, 1 <1/> shield and 1 <2/> shield, wherever they are in your tableau
per.shield.set.same: for each set of 3 identical shields, wherever they are in your tableau
per.shield.diff: for each different type of shield (among the 6) in your tableau
per.shield.diff.missing: for each different type of shield (among the 6) missing in your tableau
per.shield.diff.line: for each different type of shield (among the 6) in this row
per.shield.diff.column: for each different type of shield (among the 6) in this column
per.card.shield.1: for each card in your tableau that contains a single shield, regardless of the type
per.card.shield.2: for each card in your tableau that contains two shields, regardless of the type
per.place.castle: for each Castle banner in your tableau (Castle characters)
per.place.castle.neighbor: for each Castle banner (Castle characters) in a neighbor's tableau (the one with the most)
per.place.village: for each Village banner in your tableau (Village characters)
per.place.village.3: for each set of 3 Village banners (Village characters) in your tableau
per.place.set.both: for each set of 1 Castle banner (Castle characters) and 1 Village banner (Village characters) in your tableau
per.purse: for each Gold stored on this card at the end of the game (this purse can store a maximum of {gold} Gold)
per.gold-on-purse: for each Gold stored on all the cards with purses in your tableau
per.card-with-purse: for each card with a Purse in its Scoring scroll
per.discount: for each card with a discount power (Castle, Village or both)
per.cost: for each card with a cost of {cost} Gold
per.cost.up: for each card with a cost of at least {cost} Gold
per.different-cost: for each different Gold cost among the cards in your tableau
per.sum-costs.row: equal to the sum of costs in the same row
per.sum-costs.column: equal to the sum of costs in the same column
per.slot.empty: for each empty location in your tableau
per.slot.full: for each occupied position in your tableau
per.lock-card: for each lock card in your tableau
messenger.help:
The Messenger Pawn is at the {place, select, 1{Castle} other{Village}}.
The active player must buy or take face-down a card from this place.
By spending a Key, it is possible to move the Messenger or renew the 3 cards from the place where it is located.
gold.help: Gold is used to buy cards, and can be stored on cards with a Purse to earn points at the end of the game.
gold.card: There is {gold} Gold on this card.
keys.help:
<0>Each Key</0> earns <0>1 point</0> at the end of the game.
At the start of your turn, you can discard 1 (and only one) Key in order to move the Messenger, or renew all 3 cards in the location where it is.
keys.you: You have {keys, plural, one{# Key} other{# Keys}}.
keys.player: {player} has {keys, plural, one{# Key} other{# Keys}}.
move.move-messenger: Move the Messenger to the {place, select, 1{Castle} other{Village}}
tuto.welcome: Welcome to the Castle Combo tutorial!
tuto.recruit: Each turn, you'll recruit one of these characters and place it in your personal tableau.
tuto.tableau: Once you've recruited 9 characters to form a 3x3 square, the game is over. The player whose tableau scores the most points wins.
tuto.cost: Each character has a Gold cost, indicated here.
tuto.cost.your: Here's your gold: all players start with 15 Gold coins.
tuto.recruit.stonemason: Recruit the Stonemason by moving her here, in your tableau.
tuto.cost.auto: You will automatically pay its cost of 3 Gold coins.
tuto.discount: The Stonemason gives you a discount of 1 Gold coin on all future characters you recruit <bold>in the Village</bold>.
tuto.village:
Village characters are on this line.
In the Village, you can mostly find <bold>Military</bold> <shield1/>, <bold>Craftsmen</bold> <shield2/> and <bold>Peasants</bold> <shield3/>.
tuto.castle: At the Castle, we mostly find <bold>Nobles</bold> <shield1/>, <bold>Religious</bold> <shield2/> and <bold>Scholars</bold> <shield3/>.
tuto.messenger: This is the Messenger pawn. It indicates in which line you are allowed to recruit.
tuto.messenger.stonemason: This icon on the Stonemason indicates that the Messenger is moving to the Castle.
tuto.opponent.duchess: Your opponent has bought the Duchess. She immediately earned him 2 Keys: let's see what they're good for.
tuto.shields.points: Your Stonemason earns 3 points for each <shield/> shield in the same column (including her).
tuto.potter:
This Potter would be very interesting as he brings 2 <shield/> shields.
Unfortunately, the Messenger is at the Castle, so you can't recruit him at the moment.
tuto.spend.key:
At the start of your turn, you can spend 1 (and only 1) key to move the messenger, or to discard and replace the 3 cards in the Messenger's location.
Please note: each key earns 1 point at the end of the game!
<bold>Spend a key.</bold>
tuto.recruit.potter:
And now, recruit the Potter by placing him adjacent to your Stonemason.
Remember, though, the effect of the Stonemason! 
<italic>Click on the Stonemason if you need to review her effect.</italic>
tuto.potter.bag: The Potter has a Purse that can hold up to 4 gold coins, and each coin on it scores 2 points at the end of the game.
tuto.potter.effect: What's more, thanks to his power, the Potter immediately places 2 gold coins from the bank on all cards with a Purse in your tableau.
tuto.end.gold: At the end of the game, if you have any Gold left, it will automatically be placed on your cards with a Purse before the final countdown.
tuto.hidden.card: Each turn, instead of buying a card, you can always place one of the available cards <bold>face-down</bold> in your tableau: it won't score, but you'll immediately gain 6 Gold coins and 2 Keys.
tuto.card.click:
At any time, you can click on a card to find out its effects.
At the end of the game, each player scores the points for the cards in their tableau, plus 1 point for each Key in their possession.
The highest score wins (and remaining Gold in stock breaks ties).
<bold>Now it's your turn to play, good luck!</bold>
outOfTheOubliette.help: Adds 12 new characters with unique abilities
extension.title: Out of the Oubliette
extension.intro: This game includes the Out of the Oubliette extension! It adds 12 new cards with a lock mechanic.
extension.lock.title: Lock cards
extension.lock.desc: Some cards have a lock ability. When you buy one, a key is automatically placed on it.
extension.activate.title: Activating a lock
extension.activate.desc: Once per turn, you can spend the key on a lock card to trigger its ability. The key is consumed.
extension.scoring.title: Scoring
extension.scoring.desc: At the end of the game, each unused key still on a lock card is worth 1 point.
